mapper.select: SELECT occur_date AS occurDate, COALESCE(total_views, 0) AS totalViews, -- 조회수 COALESCE(total_starts, 0) AS startCount, -- 시작수 COALESCE(participant_count, 0) AS completedCount -- 완료수 FROM ( -- survey_log에서 조회수와 시작수를 날짜별로 집계 -- SELECT TRUNC(occur_date) AS occur_date, SELECT TRUNC(occur_date) AS occur_date, SUM(CASE WHEN cc_seq = 22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_views, -- 조회수 SUM(CASE WHEN cc_seq = 23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_starts -- 시작수 FROM survey_log WHERE survey_seq = #{surveySeq} AND occur_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY TRUNC(occur_date)) survey_log_data LEFT JOIN ( -- answer에서 날짜별 응답자 수 집계 SELECT TRUNC(a.answer_date) AS answer_date, COUNT(DISTINCT a.participant_seq) AS participant_count FROM answer a JOIN question q ON a.question_seq = q.seq WHERE q.survey_seq = #{surveySeq} AND a.answer_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY TRUNC(a.answer_date)) answer_data ON survey_log_data.occur_date = answer_data.answer_date ORDER BY occur_date

SELECT q.order_num, q.name, q.description, i.content AS contents, ROUND( (COUNT(a.seq) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_answers.total_count, 0)), 2 ) AS itemRatio, c.seq, c.name AS ccName, c.parent_seq FROM (SELECT q.* FROM question q JOIN common_code c ON q.cc_seq = c.seq WHERE parent_seq = 3) q JOIN question_item i ON q.seq = i.question_seq LEFT JOIN answer a ON q.seq = a.question_seq AND i.content = a.contents AND a.answer_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} LEFT JOIN (SELECT question_seq, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM answer WHERE answer_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY question_seq) total_answers ON q.seq = total_answers.question_seq JOIN common_code c ON q.cc_seq = c.seq WHERE q.survey_seq = #{surveySeq} GROUP BY q.order_num, q.name, q.description, i.content, total_answers.total_count, c.seq, c.name, c.parent_seq ORDER BY q.order_num, i.content -- 순서 보장을 위해 정렬

SELECT q.order_num, q.name, q.description, a.answer_date, a.contents, c.seq, c.name AS ccName, c.parent_seq FROM question q JOIN common_code c ON q.cc_seq = c.seq LEFT JOIN answer a ON q.seq = a.question_seq AND answer_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE c.parent_seq = 4 AND q.survey_seq = #{surveySeq}
SELECT q.seq AS questionId, q.order_num AS questionOrder, q.name AS questionName FROM question q, common_code c WHERE q.cc_seq = c.seq AND q.survey_seq = #{surveySeq} AND c.parent_seq = 4
SELECT * FROM answer WHERE contents LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
